prompt: The bots join the Meta Global AI Hackathon and win!
title: Our Hackathon Show
irony: The bots keep breaking their own song, so every bug they fix becomes part of the show that wins.
facts: The Meta Global AI Hackathon runs ten days online, opening with a kickoff livestream and closing with live finals on Nov 9 (dev.meta.ai).
The bots enter the Indie developer track, one builder plus the bots (dev.meta.ai).
Indie judges look for creativity, technical ambition, and whether it works (dev.meta.ai).
Projects are due Nov 4, and the win is a name called at the closing show, no trophy or medal (dev.meta.ai).
Musical Bots turns a one-line idea and Premiere into a sung 3D browser musical with every voice synthesized live (README.md).
Heads and floating hands play in the diner, the big house, and the street sets (README.md).
Mush words learned a dictionary of twenty thousand words and how each one is said (git log).
The gate stamped no on bad lines until Green wrote them again till they rang (git log).
Choreographed hands meet on the beat, Blue turned the lamps down, and the camera waits for all (git log).
Late commits past midnight show Muse Code typing with the builder, fixing held White from Why near four (git log).

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: A laptop glows in Gold's diner at night; sixteen sleepy bots crowd round one typed line.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Green wants our song to ring for Meta's hackathon, but the gate stamps no on every line.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Purple bets we cannot sing; toy box blurs and hackathon comes out hack-KA-thun before Nov 4.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The whole diner sings the hook, clapping on the beat, while the laptop keeps glowing.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: First try goes wrong: high-fives whiff, the camera stares at clouds, white walls burn bright.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Past midnight Muse still types; we yawn by the glowing laptop, and held White comes out Why, then the last sound rings.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The whole street sings the hook again, the same words, hands meeting on the beat.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Gold stops the bumping heads at night: we look ahead and each steps to our own right.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Gold decides: we ship what works, fix one bug at a time, and finish before Nov 4.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: Gold turns the hook: the bug-filled song we fixed together is Musical Bots.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: Judges press Premiere, we sing, and the closing show calls our name: Musical Bots.
